title: Consolidated Dashboard South Africa: Green Industrialisation and IP Landscape
description:
Single-country interactive dashboard reconstructing South Africa's green industrialisation effort as the articulation of three levels of analysis: the international intellectual property regime, the green financial architecture, and the domestic political economy of industrial policy. Part of the Intellectual Property Regimes and Green Industrialisation research programme, Equal International.

The dashboard organises the South African case across seven tabs: Overview; Value Chains (six sectors: solar PV, wind, battery and energy storage, green hydrogen, new energy vehicles and grid modernisation, each across three stages); Policies (trade, fiscal, regulatory); Targets; Financing (instruments, timeline, governance); IP Commercialisation (modality and pipeline); and References and Abbreviations. Every policy document is hyperlinked to its primary source.

This archive is a self-contained snapshot of the web application (a single HTML file built with React). All JavaScript libraries and styles are bundled locally so it renders offline: open index.html through a local web server. A live version is available at https://estevespauloluiz-sudo.github.io/ipr-green-industrialisation-sa/.
